annotation.interpretation_a: The endpoint must save *only* the last WINDOW_UPDATE frame received for each stream.
annotation.interpretation_b: The endpoint may save multiple WINDOW_UPDATE frames, but is only required to apply the last one received for each stream.
annotation.justification: The clause uses 'the last' which could mean 'only the last' or 'the most recent of any saved'. This affects implementation because an endpoint could choose to buffer all WINDOW_UPDATE frames, or only the most recent one.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether the endpoint is required to save all WINDOW_UPDATE frames, or only the last one. The phrase 'the last' could be interpreted as either the most recent or the only one saved.
